verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs explicitly state agents can load tools from remote MCP servers to expand capabilities, directly supporting the story of plugging in MCP servers for tool use. This is corroborated by the framework's broader tool-calling architecture (createTool, agent tool use) but lacks deep hands-on community validation specifically of MCP client usage. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of MCP-server tool loading in practice, and more detailed docs on configuration/auth for multiple MCP servers.
